attempts.sql: WITH py_files AS (SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, line_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND file_id LIKE '%.py' AND array_length(string_split(file_id, '/')) > 3) SELECT folder_path, CAST(SUM(line_count) AS INTEGER) AS total_lines FROM py_files GROUP BY folder_path HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY folder_path;

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This calculates total Python line counts for each immediate subfolder under auto_ontology/server, using file paths to identify the subfolder and line counts to sum the Python file lines. It excludes Python files that sit directly in auto_ontology/server, while including test files and __init__.py files anywhere beneath each subfolder. Only subfolders whose summed line count is greater than 1,000 are returned, ordered by folder path.
sql: WITH py_files AS (SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, line_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND file_id LIKE '%.py' AND array_length(string_split(file_id, '/')) > 3) SELECT folder_path, CAST(SUM(line_count) AS INTEGER) AS total_lines FROM py_files GROUP BY folder_path HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY folder_path;
